ns2:section.sectionText: Topic Title: Outsiders: Rebels, Troublemakers, and Deviants Representations in popular and literary Spanish texts of non-conforming individuals and marginalized groups, including Roma people, sexual rebels, foreigners, "marimachos," uppity women, and others. Texts are in Spanish; participants are invited to communicate in Spanish or English. Students are required to log in and use Compass2g (compass2g.illinois.edu) in order to complete this course.
